news.api_views module

API views for the news application.

This module defines API views and permission classes for managing articles and newsletters. It handles authentication, role-based permissions, article subscriptions, article approval, and newsletter management.

news.serializers module

news.signals module

Signal handlers for the news application’s user roles and permissions.

This module creates Django groups and permissions after migrations and automatically assigns users to the appropriate group when their role is saved.

news.signals.assign_role_group(sender, instance, **kwargs)[source]

Assign the appropriate Django group based on the user’s role.

Existing group memberships are cleared before the user’s role group is added.

news.signals.create_role_groups(sender, **kwargs)[source]

Create role-based Django groups and assign their permissions.

The Reader, Editor, and Journalist groups receive different permissions for working with articles and newsletters.

news.signals.get_permission(model, codename, name)[source]

Create or retrieve a model-level Django permission.

news.tests module

Test suite for the news application’s API and authentication features.

This module contains automated tests for article and newsletter APIs, role-based permissions, publisher subscriptions, article approval, email notifications, API logging, user groups, and token authentication.

news.urls module

URL configuration for the news application’s API.

This module maps API endpoints to the appropriate views for managing articles, subscribed articles, approved articles, and newsletters.

news.views module

Views for the news article review and approval workflow.

This module provides views for editors to review articles, approve articles, notify subscribers by email, and send approved article data to the application’s API endpoint.

news.views.approve_article(request, article_id)[source]

Approve an article and notify its subscribers.

The approved article is saved, subscribers are notified by email, and the approved article data is sent to the application’s API.

news.views.article_review(request)[source]

Display articles that are waiting for editor approval.

Only authenticated users with the Editor role can access the article review page.

news.views.home(request)[source]

Display the landing page for the news application.

news.web_urls module

URL configuration for the article review and approval workflow.

This module maps article review and approval endpoints to their corresponding view functions.
